            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 70%, rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 30%, rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.05) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }
        .title-slide::before {
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
        }
        .title-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            padding: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px) clamp(10px, 1.5vw, 20px);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: 100px;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.05);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
        }
        .title-badge::before {
            content: '';
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent);
            animation: pulse-dot 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        @keyframes pulse-dot {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--accent-glow); }
            50% { opacity: 0.7; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px transparent; }
        }
        .title-main {
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5.5vw, 4.2rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.05;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            max-width: 900px;
        }
        .title-main .highlight {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-tertiary));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }
        .title-sub {
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.8vw, 1.2rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 300;
            max-width: 700px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
        }
        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .title-meta .divider {
            width: 1px;
            height: 14px;
            background: var(--text-dim);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PROBLEM / MOTIVATION
           =========================================== */
        .problem-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }
        .problem-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 12px);
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
        }
        .problem-card .card-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }
        .problem-card .card-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--danger);
        }
        .problem-card .card-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .problem-card.highlight-card {
            border-color: var(--border-accent);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.04);
        }
        .problem-card.highlight-card .card-value {
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .callout-bar {
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.06);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 0 clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px) clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px) 0;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .callout-bar strong {
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW
           =========================================== */
        .arch-pipeline {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            margin: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem) 0;
            flex-wrap: nowrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .arch-step {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 12px) clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            text-align: center;
            min-width: clamp(70px, 11vw, 130px);
        }
        .arch-step .step-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(2px, 0.3vw, 4px);
        }
        .arch-step .step-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .arch-step .step-name {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.82rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .arch-step.accent-step {
            border-color: var(--border-accent);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.06);
        }
        .arch-step.accent-step .step-name { color: var(--accent); }
        .arch-arrow {
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .arch-findings {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .finding-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }
        .finding-card .finding-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            margin-bottom: clamp(2px, 0.3vw, 4px);
        }
        .finding-card .finding-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(2px, 0.3vw, 4px);
        }
        .finding-card .finding-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: COMPUTE ALLOCATION (BAR CHART)
           =========================================== */
        .chart-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .chart-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.4vw, 8px);
        }
        .chart-group-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }
        .chart-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 12px);
        }
        .chart-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            min-width: clamp(100px, 16vw, 200px);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .chart-bar-container {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(22px, 3vh, 34px);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 6px);
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }
        .chart-bar {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 6px);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            padding-right: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
            width: 0;
        }
        .slide.visible .chart-bar { width: var(--bar-width); }
        .chart-bar.teal { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.7)); }
        .chart-bar.purple { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-tertiary), rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.7)); }
        .chart-bar.warm { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-secondary), rgba(255, 159, 67, 0.7)); }
        .chart-bar.dim { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--text-dim), rgba(90, 101, 120, 0.6)); }

        .chart-insight {
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.06);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 0 clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 6px) clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 6px) 0;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .chart-insight strong { color: var(--accent); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: PIXEL SHUFFLE
           =========================================== */
        .shuffle-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .shuffle-diagram {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
        }
        .pixel-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 2px;
            width: clamp(120px, 18vw, 200px);
            aspect-ratio: 1;
        }
        .pixel-cell {
            border-radius: 2px;
            aspect-ratio: 1;
        }
        .pixel-cell.c1 { background: var(--accent); }
        .pixel-cell.c2 { background: var(--accent-tertiary); }
        .pixel-cell.c3 { background: var(--accent-secondary); }
        .pixel-cell.c4 { background: var(--success); }

        .shuffle-arrow-down {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .shuffle-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .compressed-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 2px;
            width: clamp(60px, 9vw, 100px);
            aspect-ratio: 1;
        }
        .compressed-cell {
            border-radius: 2px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .compressed-cell.cc1 { background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.3); border: 1px solid var(--accent); }
        .compressed-cell.cc2 { background: rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.3); border: 1px solid var(--accent-tertiary); }
        .compressed-cell.cc3 { background: rgba(255, 159, 67, 0.3); border: 1px solid var(--accent-secondary); }
        .compressed-cell.cc4 { background: rgba(46, 213, 115, 0.3); border: 1px solid var(--success); }

        .reduction-badge {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.2rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-align: center;
        }
        .reduction-badge .big { color: var(--accent); }
        .reduction-badge .unit {
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 400;
        }

        .shuffle-details {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .shuffle-detail-item {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .shuffle-detail-item .detail-key {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .shuffle-detail-item .detail-val {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: CONTEXT LENGTH
           =========================================== */
        .context-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .context-visual {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
        }
        .context-bar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
        }
        .context-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            min-width: clamp(40px, 6vw, 70px);
            text-align: right;
        }
        .context-bar-outer {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(20px, 2.8vh, 32px);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 6px);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .context-bar-inner {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 6px);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding-left: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 10px);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
            width: 0;
        }
        .slide.visible .context-bar-inner { width: var(--bar-width); }
        .context-bar-inner.teal { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.6)); color: var(--bg-primary); }
        .context-bar-inner.purple { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-tertiary), rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.6)); color: white; }

        .context-details {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 10px);
        }
        .context-detail-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .context-detail-card .cd-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .context-detail-card .cd-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .context-detail-card .cd-value .accent { color: var(--accent); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: BENCHMARK TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .bench-table-wrap {
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }
        .bench-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
        }
        .bench-table th {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 600;
            padding: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px) clamp(5px, 0.6vw, 10px);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-accent);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.8vw, 0.72rem);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .bench-table th:first-child { text-align: left; }
        .bench-table td {
            padding: clamp(3px, 0.4vw, 6px) clamp(5px, 0.6vw, 10px);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.8vw, 0.72rem);
        }
        .bench-table td:first-child { text-align: left; color: var(--text-dim); }
        .bench-table tr:nth-child(even) td { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.015); }
        .bench-table tr:hover td { background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.04); }
        .bench-table .avg-row td {
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border-accent);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.04);
        }
        .bench-table .avg-row td:first-child { color: var(--accent); }
        .bench-table .best-val { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
        .bench-table .cat-header td {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.7vw, 0.65rem);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            padding-top: clamp(6px, 0.7vw, 10px);
        }
        .bench-table .cat-header td:first-child { color: var(--text-dim); }

        .ram-strip {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .ram-chip {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.4vw, 6px);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 6px);
            padding: clamp(4px, 0.4vw, 6px) clamp(8px, 0.8vw, 12px);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }
        .ram-chip .ram-label { color: var(--text-dim); }
        .ram-chip .ram-val { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; }
        .ram-chip.danger .ram-val { color: var(--danger); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8: ON-DEVICE DEPLOYMENT
           =========================================== */
        .deploy-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .device-grid {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 10px);
        }
        .device-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 10px) clamp(8px, 0.8vw, 12px);
        }
        .device-name {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            min-width: clamp(100px, 14vw, 180px);
        }
        .device-bar-outer {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(14px, 2vh, 22px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            border-radius: clamp(3px, 0.4vw, 6px);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .device-bar-inner {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: clamp(3px, 0.4vw, 6px);
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.5));
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
            width: 0;
        }
        .slide.visible .device-bar-inner { width: var(--bar-width); }
        .device-tokens {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            min-width: clamp(60px, 8vw, 100px);
            text-align: right;
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .deploy-highlights {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 10px);
        }
        .deploy-highlight-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }
        .deploy-highlight-card .dh-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-bottom: clamp(2px, 0.2vw, 4px);
        }
        .deploy-highlight-card .dh-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .deploy-highlight-card .dh-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 9: KEY TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaway-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .takeaway-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }
        .takeaway-card .tk-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            margin-bottom: clamp(2px, 0.3vw, 4px);
        }
        .takeaway-card .tk-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(2px, 0.3vw, 4px);
        }
        .takeaway-card .tk-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        .takeaway-card.full-width {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            border-color: var(--border-accent);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.04);
        }
        .closing-line {
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            text-align: center;
            font-family: var(--font-display);

        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');

                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });
                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (diff > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) > 30) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!container) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotEls = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotEls) return;
                this.navDotEls.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>

    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });
                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (diff > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) > 30) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!container) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotEls = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotEls) return;
                this.navDotEls.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>

    <style>
        /* ===========================================
           CSS CUSTOM PROPERTIES (THEME)
           Deep tech aesthetic with teal accent
           =========================================== */
        :root {
            /* Colors */
            --bg-primary: #060b18;
            --bg-secondary: #0c1425;
            --bg-card: #111d33;
            --bg-card-hover: #162440;
            --border-subtle: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.12);

            --text-secondary: #8a96ab;
            --text-dim: #5a6578;
            --accent: #00e5c3;
            --accent-glow: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.25);
            --accent-secondary: #ff9f43;
            --accent-tertiary: #6c63ff;
            --danger: #ff4757;
            --success: #2ed573;

            /* Typography */
            --font-display: 'Syne', sans-serif;
            --font-body: 'Lexend', sans-serif;
            --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
            --title-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.2rem, 3.2vw, 2.2rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(0.95rem, 2.2vw, 1.5rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.72rem, 1.3vw, 0.95rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.9vw, 0.78rem);
            --mono-size: clamp(0.62rem, 0.95vw, 0.82rem);

            /* Spacing */
            --slide-padding: clamp(1.2rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.8vw, 1.6rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.8vw, 0.7rem);

            /* Animation */
            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --ease-out-back: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.6s;
            --duration-slow: 0.9s;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* === VIEWPORT FITTING: MANDATORY BASE STYLES === */
        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }
        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }
        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }
        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }
        :root {
            --title-size: clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            --h2-size: clamp(1.25rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
            --h3-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
            --body-size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.125rem);
            --small-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.875rem);
            --slide-padding: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 4rem);
            --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.25rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }
        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }
        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }
        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }
        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        /* === RESPONSIVE BREAKPOINTS === */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);

            }
        }
        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }
        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL PRESENTATION STYLES
           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        /* === SLIDE BACKGROUND === */
        .slide {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
        }
        .slide::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.02) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.02) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* === AMBIENT GLOW === */
        .slide::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 20%;
            right: -10%;
            width: 50%;
            height: 60%;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.04) 0%, transparent 70%);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .slide-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* === TYPOGRAPHY === */
        h1, h2, h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }
        h1 { font-size: var(--title-size); }
        h2 { font-size: var(--h2-size); }
        h3 { font-size: var(--h3-size); font-weight: 700; }

        p, li {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.5;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .mono {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
        }

        .accent { color: var(--accent); }
        .accent-warm { color: var(--accent-secondary); }
        .accent-purple { color: var(--accent-tertiary); }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(25px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }
        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.65s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(8) { transition-delay: 0.75s; }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-30px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }
        .slide.visible .reveal-left {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateX(0);
        }

        /* Stagger delay utility */
        .delay-1 { transition-delay: 0.1s !important; }
        .delay-2 { transition-delay: 0.2s !important; }
        .delay-3 { transition-delay: 0.3s !important; }
        .delay-4 { transition-delay: 0.4s !important; }
        .delay-5 { transition-delay: 0.5s !important; }
        .delay-6 { transition-delay: 0.6s !important; }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-tertiary));
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: width 0.3s var(--ease-out-expo);
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vh, 12px);
            z-index: 9999;
        }
        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 10px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 10px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-dim);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            border: none;
            padding: 0;

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
            transform: scale(1.3);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE NUMBER
           =========================================== */
        .slide-number {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            left: var(--slide-padding);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            z-index: 2;
        }
        .slide-number span {
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 70%, rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 30%, rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.05) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }
        .title-slide::before {
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
        }
        .title-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            padding: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px) clamp(10px, 1.5vw, 20px);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-radius: 100px;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.05);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
        }
        .title-badge::before {
            content: '';
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent);
            animation: pulse-dot 2s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        @keyframes pulse-dot {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--accent-glow); }
            50% { opacity: 0.7; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px transparent; }
        }
        .title-main {
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5.5vw, 4.2rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.05;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            max-width: 900px;
        }
        .title-main .highlight {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-tertiary));
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }
        .title-sub {
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 1.8vw, 1.2rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 300;
            max-width: 700px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
        }
        .title-meta {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        .title-meta .divider {
            width: 1px;
            height: 14px;
            background: var(--text-dim);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PROBLEM / MOTIVATION
           =========================================== */
        .problem-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }
        .problem-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 12px);
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 8px);
        }
        .problem-card .card-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }
        .problem-card .card-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--danger);
        }
        .problem-card .card-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .problem-card.highlight-card {
            border-color: var(--border-accent);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.04);
        }
        .problem-card.highlight-card .card-value {
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .callout-bar {
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.06);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 0 clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px) clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px) 0;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .callout-bar strong {
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW
           =========================================== */
        .arch-pipeline {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            margin: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem) 0;
            flex-wrap: nowrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .arch-step {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 12px) clamp(8px, 1vw, 14px);
            text-align: center;
            min-width: clamp(70px, 11vw, 130px);
        }
        .arch-step .step-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(2px, 0.3vw, 4px);
        }
        .arch-step .step-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .arch-step .step-name {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.82rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }
        .arch-step.accent-step {
            border-color: var(--border-accent);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.06);
        }
        .arch-step.accent-step .step-name { color: var(--accent); }
        .arch-arrow {
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .arch-findings {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .finding-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 1rem);
        }
        .finding-card .finding-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
            margin-bottom: clamp(2px, 0.3vw, 4px);
        }
        .finding-card .finding-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(2px, 0.3vw, 4px);
        }
        .finding-card .finding-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: COMPUTE ALLOCATION (BAR CHART)
           =========================================== */
        .chart-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .chart-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.4vw, 8px);
        }
        .chart-group-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }
        .chart-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 12px);
        }
        .chart-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--mono-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            min-width: clamp(100px, 16vw, 200px);
            text-align: right;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .chart-bar-container {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(22px, 3vh, 34px);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-radius: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 6px);
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }
        .chart-bar {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 6px);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            padding-right: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
            width: 0;
        }
        .slide.visible .chart-bar { width: var(--bar-width); }
        .chart-bar.teal { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.7)); }
        .chart-bar.purple { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-tertiary), rgba(108, 99, 255, 0.7)); }
        .chart-bar.warm { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-secondary), rgba(255, 159, 67, 0.7)); }
        .chart-bar.dim { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--text-dim), rgba(90, 101, 120, 0.6)); }

        .chart-insight {
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 195, 0.06);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            border-radius: 0 clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 6px) clamp(4px, 0.5vw, 6px) 0;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }
        .chart-insight strong { color: var(--accent); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: PIXEL SHUFFLE
           =========================================== */
        .shuffle-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }
        .shuffle-diagram {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(6px, 0.8vw, 10px);
        }
        .pixel-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
            gap: 2px;
            width: clamp(120px, 18vw, 200px);
            aspect-ratio: 1;
        }
        .pixel-cell {
            border-radius: 2px;
            aspect-ratio: 1;
        }
        .pixel-cell.c1 { background: var(--accent); }
        .pixel-cell.c2 { background: var(--accent-tertiary); }
        .pixel-cell.c3 { background: var(--accent-secondary); }
        .pixel-cell.c4 { background: var(--success); }

        .shuffle-arrow-down {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
            color: var(--accent);
        }
        .shuffle-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }

        .compressed-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 2px;
            width: clamp(60px, 9vw, 100px);
            aspect-ratio: 1;
        }
        .compressed-cell {
            border-radius: 2px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;

        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = idx;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });
                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.slides.length) return;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (diff > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let lastWheel = 0;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    const now = Date.now();
                    if (now - lastWheel < 800) return;
                    lastWheel = now;
                    if (Math.abs(e.deltaY) > 30) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + (e.deltaY > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!container) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Go to slide ' + (i + 1));
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotEls = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotEls) return;
                this.navDotEls.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Convert a single-file HTML presentation into a PPTX deck.
3	
4	Strategy: use Playwright to simulate keyboard navigation (ArrowRight) through
5	the presentation, taking a full-viewport screenshot of each slide, then
6	assemble the images into a 16:9 PPTX via python-pptx.
7	
8	A local HTTP server is started so Google Fonts and relative asset paths load
9	correctly (file:// protocol blocks cross-origin font requests).
10	
11	Usage:
12	    python html_to_pptx.py <input.html> <output.pptx> [--width 1920] [--height 1080]
13	"""
14	
15	import argparse
16	import os
17	import http.server
18	import subprocess
19	import sys
20	import tempfile
21	import threading
22	from pathlib import Path
23	
24	from PIL import Image
25	from pptx import Presentation
26	from pptx.util import Emu
27	
28	
29	# CSS selectors to count slides, tried in order
30	SLIDE_SELECTORS = [".slide", "[data-slide]", "section", "div > section"]
31	
32	
33	def _make_screenshot_script(url: str, out_dir: str, width: int, height: int) -> str:
34	    """Return a Node.js script that navigates and screenshots each slide."""
35	    selectors_js = ", ".join(f'"{s}"' for s in SLIDE_SELECTORS)
36	    return f"""\
37	const {{ chromium }} = require('playwright');
38	
39	(async () => {{
40	    const browser = await chromium.launch({{ executablePath: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH || undefined }});
41	    const page = await browser.newPage();
42	    await page.setViewportSize({{ width: {width}, height: {height} }});
43	    await page.goto('{url}', {{ waitUntil: 'networkidle' }});
44	
45	    // --- Count slides using DOM selectors ---
46	    const selectors = [{selectors_js}];
47	    let slideCount = 0;
48	    for (const sel of selectors) {{
49	        slideCount = await page.$$eval(sel, els => els.length);
50	        if (slideCount > 0) break;
51	    }}
52	
53	    // Fallback: treat the whole page as 1 slide
54	    if (slideCount === 0) slideCount = 1;
55	
56	    // Reasonable upper bound to prevent infinite loops
57	    if (slideCount > 100) slideCount = 100;
58	
59	    // --- Capture slide 1 (already visible on load) ---
60	    // Wait for entrance animations to settle
61	    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
62	    await page.screenshot({{ path: `{out_dir}/slide_001.png` }});
63	
64	    // --- Navigate through remaining slides via ArrowRight ---
65	    // We track visual changes to detect when navigation has no more effect
66	    // (i.e. we've passed the last slide).
67	    let prevPath = `{out_dir}/slide_001.png`;
68	    let captured = 1;
69	
70	    for (let i = 2; i <= slideCount; i++) {{
71	        await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
72	        // Wait for transition animation to complete
73	        await page.waitForTimeout(600);
74	
75	        const idx = String(i).padStart(3, '0');
76	        const path = `{out_dir}/slide_${{idx}}.png`;
77	        await page.screenshot({{ path }});
78	        captured++;
79	    }}
80	
81	    console.log(JSON.stringify({{ captured }}));
82	    await browser.close();
83	}})();
84	"""
85	
86	
87	def _deduplicate_slides(image_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
88	    """Remove trailing duplicate screenshots (navigation past last slide).
89	
90	    Some presentations keep showing the last slide when you press ArrowRight
91	    beyond the end.  We detect this by comparing file sizes + pixel samples.
92	    """
93	    pngs = sorted(image_dir.glob("slide_*.png"))
94	    if len(pngs) <= 1:
95	        return pngs
96	
97	    unique: list[Path] = [pngs[0]]
98	    prev_img = Image.open(pngs[0])
99	
100	    for png in pngs[1:]:
101	        curr_img = Image.open(png)
102	        # Quick check: compare a grid of sample pixels
103	        is_dup = True
104	        for x_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
105	            for y_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
106	                px = int(curr_img.width * x_frac)
107	                py = int(curr_img.height * y_frac)
108	                if curr_img.getpixel((px, py)) != prev_img.getpixel((px, py)):
109	                    is_dup = False
110	                    break
111	            if not is_dup:
112	                break
113	
114	        if not is_dup:
115	            unique.append(png)
116	            prev_img = curr_img
117	        else:
118	            # Once we hit a duplicate, stop — remaining are likely all dupes
119	            break
120	
121	    return unique
122	
123	
124	def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
125	    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
126	    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
127	    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), lambda *a, **kw: handler(*a, directory=str(directory), **kw))
128	    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
129	    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
130	    thread.start()
131	    return server, actual_port
132	
133	
134	def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
135	    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
136	    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
137	    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
138	    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
139	    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"
140	
141	    try:
142	        script = _make_screenshot_script(url, str(out_dir), width, height)
143	        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
144	        script_file.write_text(script)
145	
146	        env = os.environ.copy()
147	        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
148	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
149	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
150	        result = subprocess.run(
151	            ["node", str(script_file)],
152	            capture_output=True,
153	            text=True,
154	            timeout=180,
155	            env=env,
156	        )

127	    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), lambda *a, **kw: handler(*a, directory=str(directory), **kw))
128	    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
129	    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
130	    thread.start()
131	    return server, actual_port
132	
133	
134	def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
135	    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
136	    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
137	    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
138	    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
139	    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"
140	
141	    try:
142	        script = _make_screenshot_script(url, str(out_dir), width, height)
143	        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
144	        script_file.write_text(script)
145	
146	        env = os.environ.copy()
147	        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
148	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
149	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
150	        result = subprocess.run(
151	            ["node", str(script_file)],
152	            capture_output=True,
153	            text=True,
154	            timeout=180,
155	            env=env,
156	        )
157	        if result.returncode != 0:
158	            print(f"Playwright stderr:\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
159	            raise RuntimeError(f"Screenshot script failed (exit {result.returncode})")
160	    finally:
161	        server.shutdown()
162	
163	    pngs = _deduplicate_slides(out_dir)
164	    if not pngs:
165	        raise RuntimeError("No slide screenshots produced")
166	    return pngs
167	
168	
169	def assemble_pptx(slide_images: list[Path], output_path: Path) -> None:
170	    """Pack slide images into a standard 16:9 PPTX."""
171	    prs = Presentation()
172	    # Standard 16:9 dimensions
173	    prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 13.333 inches
174	    prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)   # 7.5 inches
175	
176	    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank layout
177	
178	    for img_path in slide_images:
179	        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
180	        slide.shapes.add_picture(
181	            str(img_path),
182	            left=Emu(0),
183	            top=Emu(0),
184	            width=prs.slide_width,
185	            height=prs.slide_height,
186	        )
187	
188	    prs.save(str(output_path))
189	
190	
191	def main():
192	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert HTML presentation to PPTX via screenshots")
193	    parser.add_argument("input_html", help="Path to the single-file HTML presentation")
194	    parser.add_argument("output_pptx", help="Output PPTX path")
195	    parser.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=1920, help="Viewport width (default 1920)")
196	    parser.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=1080, help="Viewport height (default 1080)")
197	    args = parser.parse_args()
198	
199	    html_path = Path(args.input_html).resolve()
200	    output_path = Path(args.output_pptx).resolve()
201	
202	    if not html_path.exists():
203	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Input HTML not found: {html_path}")
204	
205	    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="slides_") as tmp:
206	        tmp_dir = Path(tmp)
207	        print(f"Capturing slides from {html_path} ...")
208	        images = screenshot_slides(html_path, tmp_dir, args.width, args.height)
209	        print(f"Captured {len(images)} unique slide(s), assembling PPTX ...")
210	        assemble_pptx(images, output_path)
211	        print(f"Done → {output_path}")
212	
213	
214	if __name__ == "__main__":
215	    main()
